claim_boundary: This contract defines what must be measured. It intentionally makes no analog, hybrid, or energy-efficiency claim until all six coefficients are supplied with matched evidence.

ADC_pJ_per_conversion.scope: same comparator/SAR macro and conversion window

DAC_pJ_per_conversion.scope: same Sky130 macro, corner, voltage, and timing used by SAR receipt

array_pJ_per_evaluation.scope: same active rows, columns, weights, and accumulation mode

boundary_pJ_per_byte.scope: same movement path and voltage domain

same_target_digital_projection_pJ.scope: same GPT-2 layer, precision, batch, and target technology

ineligible_proxies.reason: simple-load converter estimate; excludes extracted converter, bias, clock, leakage, comparator, and array energy
CUDA timing and quality evidence; contains no device energy measurement

required_controls: Sky130 model bundle hash or silicon lot
measurement instrument or SPICE current probes
